Compose All 'pharmaverse' Adapters into One Evidence Table

Source: R/pharma_evidence.R
pharma_evidence.Rd

A convenience wrapper that runs the individual r4subpharma adapters and returns their combined output in a single call. It composes metacore_to_evidence() (variable-level documentation), dataset_metadata_to_evidence() (dataset-level documentation), and - when an ADaM dataset is supplied - adam_to_evidence() (dataset conformance), then row-binds the results into one R4SUB evidence table.

pharma_evidence(
  metadata,
  ctx,
  data = NULL,
  dataset_name = NULL,
  source_name = "metacore",
  source_version = NULL,
  adam_source_name = "adam",
  adam_source_version = NULL
)

Arguments

metadata

A Metacore object or a data.frame. It is forwarded unchanged to metacore_to_evidence() and dataset_metadata_to_evidence() (and, when data is supplied, to adam_to_evidence()).

ctx

An r4subcore::r4sub_run_context providing run and study identifiers.

data

An optional ADaM data.frame. When supplied, adam_to_evidence() is run as well and its rows are included.

dataset_name

Character or NULL. Passed to adam_to_evidence() to select which dataset in metadata to check data against. Ignored when data is NULL.

source_name

Character. Source label for the metadata-derived evidence (both metacore_to_evidence() and dataset_metadata_to_evidence()). Default "metacore".

source_version

Character or NULL. Optional version label for the metadata source.

adam_source_name

Character. Source label for the ADaM-derived evidence. Default "adam". Ignored when data is NULL.

adam_source_version

Character or NULL. Optional version label for the ADaM source. Ignored when data is NULL.

Value

A data.frame conforming to the R4SUB evidence schema: the row-bind of the composed adapters' outputs.

Details

This is pure composition: it introduces no new indicators or semantics of its own. The result is exactly the row-bind of the adapters' individual outputs, so every indicator, severity, result, and message is identical to calling the adapters separately and binding them yourself.

See also

metacore_to_evidence(), dataset_metadata_to_evidence(), adam_to_evidence(), submission_readiness()

Examples

# The CDISC pilot ADaM metacore specification shipped with metacore.
load(metacore::metacore_example("pilot_ADaM.rda"))
ctx <- suppressMessages(r4subcore::r4sub_run_context("CDISCPILOT01", "DEV"))
ev  <- suppressMessages(pharma_evidence(metacore, ctx))
table(ev$indicator_id)
#> 
#> Q-DEFINE-002 Q-DEFINE-003 Q-DEFINE-004 
#>          218          218            5
